# Extremely Disappointed - Worst Purchase Ever

I had high hopes for this foam mattress, but it's been nothing but a nightmare. The chemical smell was so overwhelming when I unboxed it that I had to air it out for two weeks, and it still has a faint odor. After just three months of use, there's already a noticeable body impression where I sleep, making it uncomfortable and unsupportive. My back pain has actually gotten worse since switching to this mattress, and I wake up stiff every morning. The edges collapse when you sit on them, making it feel like you'll roll right off the bed. For the price I paid, I expected much better quality and durability. Customer service was unhelpful when I reached out about the sagging issue. I definitely do not recommend this mattress and deeply regret this purchase.
